description: Inspect tables and column types in a canvas_id returned by drought_get_timeseries or drought_compare_areas. Supply table_name for its complete source query, area/date/metric, units, missing-data and provenance metadata. Omit table_name for bounded schema summaries. Tokens are shareable capabilities and expire; this tool never lists other tokens.

canvas_id.description: Token returned by a drought producer.

metadata_field.description: Retained metadata collection to page; requires table_name.

metadata_limit.description: Default 20 metadata items per page; values above 100 are clamped with disclosure.

metadata_offset.description: Items to skip in the retained metadata snapshot.

anyOf.description: SQL identifier of an existing staged table.

table_name.description: Table name from the stage handle; omit for schema summaries.

name: drought_dataframe_describe

effectiveLimit.description: Effective metadata page ceiling after clamping to 100.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_metadata_page`: Metadata pagination lacks a named table or uses an unavailable collection. `canvas_unavailable`: Analytical provider is unavailable. `canvas_not_found`: Token is absent, expired or belongs to another tenant. `missing_table`: The requested table is absent. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

metadata_page.description: Requested count of complete metadata items, fewer only at exhaustion.

items.description: Unchanged complete items from the retained snapshot.

next_offset.description: Next offset, or null at the end.

tables.description: Tables only in this specified canvas.

items.description: One table in the supplied canvas with its explicit schema.
One SQL column and its nullability.

metadata.description: Complete producer metadata for a requested table; empty for summaries.

totalCount.description: Total items in the requested retained metadata collection.

title: Describe staged drought tables
